id: Buka dokumen Word, Excel, dan PowerPoint: Lembar mengubahnya ke PDF lewat Microsoft Office, WPS Office, atau LibreOffice yang terpasang, lalu bisa digabung dengan file lain.
Isian formulir di file hasil sekarang bisa dicari dan disalin.
Status bar bahasa Inggris menulis "1 page" dan "1 file" dengan benar.
en: Open Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents: Lembar converts them to PDF through an installed Microsoft Office, WPS Office, or LibreOffice, then they can be merged with other files.
Form entries in the saved file can now be searched and copied.
The English status bar now says "1 page" and "1 file" correctly.
